text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed for every task. In supervised learning, the computer is given training data that includes both inputs and the correct outputs. The computer uses this data to create a model, which is like a set of rules or patterns. Once the model is trained, it can make predictions on new, unseen data. For example, a model trained on many pictures of cats and dogs can predict whether a new picture contains a cat or a dog. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model has learned.
